Common.IncrementalHelpText:
Incremental mode:
1.Unchecked: Full pack
2.Add/Modify: Only modified/new files, unchanged files not repacked
3.Add/Mod/Delete: Compare pack dir with data pack, clean files not in pack dir, unchanged files not repacked

Incremental verification:
ARZ uses external .ckm checksum files.
ARC uses built-in checksum fields in entries.

Incremental data packing:
E.g. file a.dbr modified:
1. Rename original a.dbr to empty (tombstone)
2. Append new a.dbr at end of pack

Same mechanism as ArchiveTool.exe update parameter.

Impact:
1. Many increments create many empty names (no effect on unpack)
2. Many increments can bloat pack size

Resolution:
Compact: repacks all data, ignores empty names and original data

Common.CkmHelpText:
Checksum file (.ckm) enables fast change detection for incremental packing.

Extracts all records from ARZ/ARC and computes Adler32 checksums,
saves as [filename.ext.ckm] in the same directory.

On incremental pack, compares checksums with source files,
only packs changed records for much faster packing.

Note: first extraction from externally-generated ARZ/ARC
requires decompressing all records.
